security_audit.summary: The skill is useful for PPTX creation and editing, but it relies on local scripts, archive extraction, generated JavaScript, global package installation, and external document converters. Most hardcoded URL, schema, Markdown backtick, and OOXML namespace findings are false positives, but unsafe extractall usage, privileged install instructions, and external converter execution are confirmed risks.

remediation.issue: Unsafe ZIP extraction of Office files
remediation.suggestion: Replace ZipFile.extractall with member-by-member extraction that rejects absolute paths and paths escaping the destination directory.
Remove sudo, global npm, and broad pip install instructions from normal workflows. Prefer pinned local environments and user-managed prerequisites.
Run LibreOffice, Poppler, and generated Node scripts with explicit user consent, sandboxing, timeouts, and resource limits.

remediation.issue: Bundled npm tarball lacks marketplace transparency
remediation.suggestion: Publish reviewable source, lock dependency versions, and document package integrity checks before installation.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint workflows often require precise layout, template matching, and XML-level fixes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PPTX creation, editing, validation, and review.
actual_capabilities: Create new PPTX decks from HTML slide files using the bundled html2pptx workflow.
Edit existing PowerPoint files by unpacking and modifying OOXML document parts.
Generate thumbnail grids to inspect slide layout, contrast, and formatting issues.
Inventory template slides and text shapes before selecting layouts or replacing content.
Replace text while preserving paragraph formatting, bullets, alignment, fonts, and colors.
Validate modified Office files against local OOXML schema and relationship checks.
limitations: Requires local Python, Node, LibreOffice, Poppler, and related presentation libraries.
Uses command-line scripts and file conversion tools that need explicit user oversight.
Complex animations, macros, and proprietary PowerPoint effects may not round-trip exactly.
Template-based edits depend on accurate slide inventory and careful placeholder mapping.

use_cases.title: Repair PPTX structure
use_cases.description: Unpack a presentation, inspect OOXML parts, fix references or formatting, and repack the document after validation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 6-slide PowerPoint presentation about [topic]. Include a title slide, four content slides, and a closing slide.

prompt_templates.title: Use a branded template
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with an existing template file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [template.pptx] to create a presentation for [audience]. Inventory the template, choose suitable slide layouts, and replace the text.

prompt_templates.title: Review and improve layout
prompt_templates.scenario: Quality review after a draft deck exists.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [deck.pptx], generate thumbnail grids, identify layout or readability problems, and revise the presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Edit OOXML safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced repair or precise edit request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Unpack [deck.pptx], modify the requested slide XML, validate the OOXML structure, and repack the corrected file.

output_examples.input: Create a 5-slide strategy update for executives.
output_examples.output: A PowerPoint deck with a title slide, agenda, strategy summary, metrics slide, recommendation slide, and presenter notes.

output_examples.input: Apply this content to our corporate template.
output_examples.output: A template-based deck with selected layouts, replaced placeholder text, preserved styling, and a thumbnail grid for review.

output_examples.input: Fix the broken image reference on slide 4.
output_examples.output: A repaired PPTX file with corrected OOXML relationships and validation results that identify remaining issues if any exist.

best_practices: Start with a slide outline, target audience, visual tone, and required template constraints.
Generate thumbnails after each major edit and inspect text overflow, contrast, and alignment.
Validate OOXML changes before repacking and keep a copy of the original presentation.
anti_patterns: Do not run privileged package installation commands as part of normal deck creation.
Do not choose template layouts before counting the actual content and placeholders.
Do not edit OOXML relationships without validating references, content types, and slide IDs.

faq.question: Can this skill create a PowerPoint file from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses HTML slide files, PptxGenJS, and html2pptx to create a new PPTX deck.

faq.question: Can it work with existing PowerPoint templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inventory template slides, select layouts, duplicate slides, and replace text while preserving style.

faq.question: Does it support visual review?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes thumbnail grid workflows for checking layout, contrast, overflow, and slide consistency.

faq.question: Does it edit raw PowerPoint XML?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides OOXML workflows for unpacking, editing, validating, and repacking PPTX files.

faq.question: What dependencies are required?
faq.answer: The workflows expect Python packages, Node packages, LibreOffice, Poppler, and PowerPoint-related libraries to be available.

faq.question: Is automatic installation recommended?
faq.answer: No. Dependency installation should be reviewed by the user, especially global npm, pip, and sudo package commands.
